In-orbit demonstration of intelligent power supply unit for micro spacecraft.
Description

We will perform an in-orbit demonstration of an intelligent power supply unit that can acquire status data of batteries installed in micro spacecraft and quickly detect battery deterioration and abnormalities in orbit.
Notes

As of 2023 the size of the satellites is an educational guess.
